text: The initiative utilizes over 1 million plausible earthquake scenarios to create national-scale exceedance maps, which are then used for local-scale modeling. It employs open-source BSD-licensed codes and Pacific Islands-tailored guidance. The approach includes hazard deaggregation to identify dominant sources and a practical 'local model' approach to manage computational costs while achieving site resolution.

metadata.solution_name: Probabilistic Tsunami Hazard Assessment for Vanimo Port Design (PTHA–Vanimo)
